items.title: Junior Mance Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995…
items.q: With Houston Person on saxophone and Alvin Queen on drums and Calvin Hill on bass.

ctx.x: With Houston Person on saxophone and Alvin Queen on drums and Calvin Hill on bass. And we did it again with the horn. But what you say about under the sheets, well I guess I was about ten years old and my dad asked me one Christmas, “What do you want for Christmas?” You know I said, “I want a table radio.” You know this was before they had the little battery portables and all of that. And he was shocked. He thought what does he want a radio for? Well they would listen to all the broadcasts at night, you know like…

I share this with you so you won’t feel alone. I used to do the same thing and my parents asked me what I wanted for Christmas and I said a transistor radio. And I was a little more discreet because at this time when they come out with the transistor radios, they also had earplugs. And they forbade us from listening to music after eleven o’clock. After eleven o’clock is when all the greatest rhythm & blues would come on. And so we would pretend to be asleep and we would, just before we went to sleep we would find…
